verdict.rationale: Plymouth Street is an immigration-services provider that advertises status dashboards and integration with People Ops, so a buyer could reasonably ask about a programmatic API. The evidence pack documents no API, no versioning, and no deprecation policy, and probes for OpenAPI and llms.txt endpoints all returned 404. With no evidence for an applicable capability, the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
